APPROVE
The extraction moves the three loops verbatim in the same order, which leaves `InScript` at about 5, well below 15. It builds only if `projectReset`, `keyframes` and `guards` really are, or convert to, `Func<Family, bool>`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, bool>` and `IReadOnlySet<string>`, and the callees (`InStyleSheet`, `Known`, `ReadsGuard`, `ScriptGuarded`) accept those types; I couldn't find the source file here to confirm this, so check it with a build before merging.
